claims.statement: A distributor is the store (门店) concept — one row in distribution_distributor, the pickup/delivery shop a member selects at checkout — owned by ecshopx-distribution, while the promoter (推广员/分销员, member-turned-referrer with QR codes and brokerage rows) is owned by ecshopx-popularize; the two bundles split the 'distribution' namespace between store concepts and promoter concepts.

distribution_distributor_items (the per-shop copy of the catalog) is populated by the goods bundle, not the distribution bundle: DistributorGoodsSyncService.syncGoods in ecshopx-goods and job:62 DistributionBundle\Jobs\AddDistributorItems perform the fan-out to stores flagged auto_sync_goods.

DistributorCreateService.performInsertAndEvents enforces per-company application-level uniqueness guards — duplicate shop_code (店铺编号已存在), mobile (店铺手机号已存在), wdt_shop_no (旺店通门店已绑定其他店铺), jst_shop_id (聚水潭店铺已绑定其他店铺), and the distributor_self singleton (总部自提店铺已存在) — plus mobile format validation that also accepts the synthetic WeCom d-d-d mobile pattern.

The first non-wxapp-sourced store becomes the company default automatically: needDefault = sourceFrom != 2 && !existsDefaultDistributor(companyId); source 1 is admin, 2 wxapp self-registered, 3 openapi.

DistributorCreateOrchestrator registers a TransactionSynchronization whose afterCommit enqueues job:63 (ThemeBundle\Jobs\CreateDistributorJob, slow queue, ASYNC REDIS) BEFORE calling distributionAddEventDispatchPublisher.publish, and that publisher publishes the same row snapshot twice — event:281 and event:289, both ASYNC REDIS — a deliberate dual CSV-plane publish.

The dual DistributionAdd publishes split their listeners by bus plane: event:281 carries the third-party marketing-center push (listener:thirdparty.distribution_add_push_marketing_center, async default queue) and youshu, while event:289 carries the HfPay HfEnterapplyInit listener (async default queue).

DistributorCreateEvent (event:263) is published inside the create transaction in SYNC mode — DispatchOptions.eventDefaults() is DispatchMode.SYNC — so listener SystemLinkBundle\Listeners\ShopCreateSendOme runs inline before commit while shuyun.open_platform.shop_sync_on_distributor_create runs async; the same pattern applies to DistributorUpdateEvent (event:264) with ShopUpdateSendOme on update.

DistributorUpdateOrchestrator afterCommit publishes DistributionEditEvent first (dual CSV event:282 + event:290, ASYNC REDIS — 282 carrying marketing-center push and youshu, 290 carrying HfPay HfEnterapplyInit@edit) and only then DistributorUpdateEvent (event:264, SYNC).

DistributorUpdateService.performUpdateAndEvents applies only a whitelisted COLUMN_KEYS set (~55 column names), forces is_default=1 when no default exists, and when is_audit_goods flips from true to falsy it bulk-approves all shop-scoped items via ItemsAuditByDistributorJdbcRepository.updateAuditStatusApprovedByDistributorId — disabling item audit must not leave submitted items stuck.

PUT /distributor/{id}/payment-subject parses payment_subject through a sealed interface PaymentSubjectParse with three outcomes: Valid(0|1), Invalid (Dingo 422 payment_subject参数错误，只能为0（平台）或1（店铺）), and SqlBug — a missing/null/empty-string value deliberately reproduces the legacy MySQL 1366 'Incorrect integer value' error as HTTP 200 with Dingo message/status_code 500, matching the old client contract.

DistributorPaymentSubjectService.setPaymentSubject refuses to switch while the store has unfinished refunds (有未完成的退款单，不允许切换收款主体); switching to shop subject (1) requires at least one open payment channel (WeChat Pay or Alipay) and complete per-shop channel config for every open channel, while switching to platform (0) validates the platform (distributor 0) channel config.

The legacy PHP route POST …/v1/shops (Javadoc-referenced as DistributorShopController#createShops, with no separate Java controller class) is converged onto the same DistributorCreateOrchestrator and shares its afterCommit job/event publish order with POST /api/v1/distributor; the entry03_shopsCreateRoute_* case in DistributorCreateOrchestratorDistributionAddDispatchPublishProbeTest asserts this route parity.

OpenapiThirdApiV2DistributorCreateService.executeOpenapiCreate is a third distributor-create entrypoint that bypasses the orchestrator: it inserts the row directly in a TransactionTemplate with source_from=3, is_valid=false, review_status=true, and encrypted contact/mobile, then in afterCommit enqueues job:63, the dual DistributionAdd publish, and DistributorCreateEvent — all three entrypoints end with the same fan-out shape.

job:63 ThemeBundle\Jobs\CreateDistributorJob is handled by CreateDistributorJobHandler in ecshopx-theme which delegates to PagesTemplateNewDistributorFacade.applyDefaultTemplatesForNewDistributor in ecshopx-distribution to bind default storefront page templates for the new store.

Merchant wxapp login (mobile + SMS vcode + company_id) finds or creates the merchant_settlement_apply row (initial audit_status=1, source=h5, disabled=true) and returns an HS256 JWT issued by MerchantWxappJwtIssuer with subject merchantaccount_{id} and claims account_id/company_id/mobile/operator_type=user plus iss/nbf/exp from MerchantWxappJwtProperties.

The FrontMerchantAuth JWT plane has two parallel guards — the servlet-level MerchantWxappJwtAuthenticationFilter (POST settlementapply/**, POST password/reset, and four specific GETs) and the MVC FrontMerchantAuthInterceptor (annotation-driven) — both verifying HS256 signature, issuer, and exp/nbf with leewaySeconds and then reloading the merchant_settlement_apply row; a deleted apply invalidates an unexpired token, but a refused apply stays authenticated because step 3 re-submission resets audit_status back to pending.

Merchant settlement apply saves persist only steps 1–3 (1: settled_type+merchant_type; 2: merchant identity/address/bank with encrypted PII; 3: license/cert images which can reset a refused apply back to pending); the progress resolver derives step 4 from license_url presence as the awaiting-audit state, and any other step value is rejected with 入驻信息填写步骤错误.

Only audit_status=1 (pending) applies are auditable; a passing audit materializes the merchant row (mirroring apply fields plus settlement_apply_id), its multi-language shards, and the main operator via CompanysMerchantMainOperatorProvisioner in ecshopx-companys, then enqueues job:1 AuditSuccessNotice, while failure enqueues job:2 AuditFailNotice (jobs 3/4 are enter-success and password-reset notices).

Salesperson wxapp auth is session-header based, not JWT: QywxSalespersonAuthInterceptor (@QywxSalespersonAuth-annotated handlers) delegates to WxappSalespersonSessionAuthService, which reads x-wxapp-session from the shared wechat Redis as frontSession3rd:{token}, cross-checks the session JSON against the DB shop_salesperson row (company_id + work_userid + allowed salesperson_type + is_valid=true, throwing 会话与库不一致 on type mismatch), lets the DB salesperson_id override the session's, and injects distributor_id from the first store_type=distributor shops_rel_salesperson row ordered by lowest shop_id (0 when unbound).

Admin /api/v1/salesperson/task CRUD creates tasks of types 1–4 (share, new-user, user-order, user-welfare) scoped to all distributors (use_all_distributor=1) or a selected subset, and rejects overlapping same-type tasks in the time window with 此时间段存在该类型任务 via countOverlappingAllDistributorTasks/countOverlappingPartialTasks.

Salesperson task completion enqueues job:45 SalespersonTask (handled by SalespersonTaskJobHandler, which pushes completion to the marketing center via MarketingCenterTasksCompletePort); member↔guide relationship continuity is job:46; shelf recomputation is job:138 SalespersonItemsShelvesJob; and job:139 through job:149 are aliases of the same bus message name — one handler registration, many legacy PHP trigger rows.

On trade finish, NormalOrderFinishBrokerageCoordinator.onNormalOrderFinishBrokerage computes first-level brokerage inside its own transaction: it skips unless the company's open_popularize setting is literal-true, is idempotent per order (existing brokerage rows short-circuit), requires the buyer to be a promoter with a pid parent who is an active promoter (is_promoter=1), computes the rebate as order base (money or profit per config) × first-level ratio percent rounded and capped at Integer.MAX_VALUE fen, inserts a brokerage row of type first_level, and enqueues the promoter grade-upgrade job.
Promoter QR codes are WeChat unlimited-type codes (WxaUnlimitedQrcodeClient.getUnlimitedCodeBytes, scene puid=) returned base64-encoded to the front end.

CommunityChiefQrWriteoffService.executeQrWriteoff is the group-buy write-off path: it resolves the ziti QR code from Redis to an order, requires the community_order_rel_activity row to belong to the invoking chief (只能核销自己开团的订单), rejects already-DONE orders (该订单已完成自提，请重新确认) and orders with pending cancel requests (订单有未处理的取消申请，不能核销), then delegates the state transition to NormalOrderZitiWriteoffService.orderZitiWriteoffForChief in the orders bundle rather than duplicating order status logic.

supplier_order rows are per-supplier projections created by SupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddService.split (physically in ecshopx-orders, package cn.shopex.ecshopx.supplier.service): for each distinct supplier it inserts one row with aggregated fen sums and NOTPAY statuses, guarded by an existence check on (company_id, order_id, user_id, supplier_id) so re-running is a no-op; the production trigger is a direct synchronous call in both normal-order-create orchestrators (after the transactional runner, before publishing event:orders:normal_order_add), while OrdersSupplierOrderSplitOnNormalOrderAddDispatchListener wraps the same service on the bus plane with no production registration — only tests register it.

Distributor deletion is soft only — is_valid is a string axis set to delete, never a physical delete — and money amounts in this domain are integer fen (brokerage_fee, supplier order sums), with HfPay rate in basis points and payment_subject 0=platform / 1=shop collection.

The afterCommit orderings and dual publishes are pinned by dedicated tests: DistributorCreateOrchestratorDistributionAddDispatchPublishProbeTest (create, including the entry03_shopsCreateRoute_* legacy-route case), DistributorUpdateOrchestratorDistributionEditDispatchPublishProbeTest (update), the DistributionAdd/DistributionEdit dual-publish facade probe tests, and the DistributorCreate/UpdateEvent SYNC bus dispatch flow tests.
